_note: Descriptions of callsigns that came from a LIVE ANALYST outside this pipeline - never inferred
by us and never derived from the corpus. They outrank the archived roster when both speak about
the same man, because they carry rank and post, which the archive's role column does not.
Each entry is scoped by `formation`: EVERY token of it must appear in the report block's header
before the note is applied. This is the whole safety of the file. МАРС is the case that proves
it - the name also stands on 141.2500 under `2 мсб 71 мсп 42 мсд 58 А`, a different division
entirely, and an unscoped note would have labelled that man a medic of 38 омсбр.
`aliases` exists because the same man is written in Russian and Ukrainian spelling in different
places (`Лысый` from the analyst, `ЛИСИЙ` in our archive).
Never put a guess in this file. If we inferred it, it belongs in tools/callsign_roles, which is
measured against the analyst rather than treated as truth.
`add_to_net` lets a note INSERT a man who is not in the archive roster of that block. Only for notes scoped to his OWN net - never for a brigade-wide one.
